title: Shoals Joins Current/OS to Advance the Future of Direct Current Power Systems
summary: For 30 years, Shoals has powered utility-scale solar using electrical balance of system (EBOS) solutions. Today, we deliver fast, scalable DC architectures for data centers, storage, and AI-driven energy demands.
body_markdown:
### **September 17, 2026**


Shoals Technologies Group, Inc. (“Shoals”) (Nasdaq: SHLS), a global leader in electrical infrastructure solutions for the energy transition market, today announced its partnership with[Current/OS](https://currentos.org/) a nonprofit, open industry partnership working to accelerate reliable, sustainable hybrid AC/DC power distribution across data centers and other emerging applications.


Through this partnership, Shoals will contribute its decades of experience designing and deploying[DC power solutions](https://shoals.com/en/insights/dc-architectures-in-next-generation-energy-systems/) at scale while collaborating with industry leaders to help shape the future of DC standards, interoperability, and system design.


Direct current power plays a critical role across renewable energy, energy storage, and emerging data center applications. By participating in Current/OS, Shoals will help drive industry-wide innovation that supports more efficient, reliable, and scalable power systems.


> “As solar, storage, and data centers continue to scale, DC is becoming a foundational part of modern power infrastructure,” said[Justin Siefkes](https://www.linkedin.com/in/justin-siefkes-se/) , VP of Product and Engineering at Shoals Technologies Group. “Shoals has spent decades solving DC challenges at scale, with a focus on simplifying power distribution, reducing connection points, and improving long-term reliability. Joining Current/OS gives us an opportunity to bring that experience to a broader industry collaboration and help advance the standards and interoperable architectures needed for the next generation of DC power systems.”


By joining Current/OS, Shoals further expands its commitment to advancing innovative power solutions that support the evolving needs of customers across renewable energy, energy storage, and digital infrastructure markets.


**About Shoals Technologies Group**


Shoals Technologies Group is a leading manufacturer of advanced electrical infrastructure solutions for mission critical applications across utility scale solar, battery storage, and data center power systems. Since its founding in 1996, the Company has designed innovative technologies and systems solutions that allow its customers to substantially increase installation efficiency and safety while improving system performance and reliability at scale. Shoals Technologies Group is a recognized leader in the energy transition industry. For additional information, please visit:[https://www.shoals.com](https://www.shoals.com/) .
